boards.name: Porter’s five forces
boards.description: Assess an industry’s competitive pressure — rivals, new entrants, substitutes, buyer power and supplier power — and what it means for strategy.

cards.title: Five forces — specialty coffee subscriptions (UK)
cards.body: How attractive is the market Hollow Oak is pushing into? Each force rated low / medium / high, with evidence.

cards.title: How to use this template
cards.body: Rate each force with evidence, not instinct. The centre card is rivalry; the four around it push on it. Finish with what the forces mean for us.

cards.title: Threat of new entrants — HIGH
cards.body: Low cost to start a roaster brand online; white-label roasting exists.

cards.title: Supplier power — MEDIUM
cards.body: Green coffee prices volatile; direct-trade relationships reduce risk.

cards.title: Competitive rivalry — HIGH
cards.body: Dozens of roasters online; supermarkets moving into “specialty”.

cards.title: Buyer power — HIGH
cards.body: Switching is one click; price comparisons easy.

cards.title: Threat of substitutes — MEDIUM
cards.body: Pods, café coffee, tea. Home brewing habit is sticky once formed.

cards.title: So what?
cards.body: Compete on freshness, flexibility and community — things a white-label brand can’t copy fast. Lock in habit early.
